dict.string: PandaPlate uses the camera when you open Food Scan so you can take one still photo of your meal to log. You can also choose a photo from your library.
PandaPlate lets you choose a meal photo from your library for Food Scan so you can log what you ate without taking a new picture.

PandaPlate reads steps, active energy, exercise time, and workouts from Apple Health only when you choose Connect — to show today’s movement and optionally log workouts. We don’t write to Health in this version.
